verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order (image, eyebrow, headline, date, venue, logo), but the date block is shrunk until its 'Tuesday to Sunday' line can't be read. The address breaks awkwardly into '4 / Kiln Lane', and the logo is blown up so large that it competes with the headline. B scrambles the reading order: the date bar sits at the very top, the 'EXHIBITION' label falls below the headline it should introduce, and the photo is pushed into the middle. Its date text is just as unreadable, though B keeps the address on one line and the logo at a sensible size.
